fields.name: image
fields.label: Desktop media
fields.description: Desktop background image shown at 769px and above. For a background video, put a link to an .mp4 in the Content field's first line instead of using an image.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile media
fields.description: Optional mobile background image shown below 769px. Falls back to the desktop media when empty.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Title (as a heading), a tagline paragraph, and a link for the CTA button. Alt text for images is taken from the title automatically.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Disclaimer
fields.description: Optional fine print shown at the bottom of the slide.
